leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define TypeScript interfaces to structure form state with fields, values, and validation errors
Implement a useForm custom hook to manage form state and lifecycle
Apply useState hooks to store and update form field values dynamically
Utilize event handlers to capture and process user input from form elements
Construct validation functions to check field values against defined rules
Execute conditional rendering to display validation error messages when rules are violated
Use controlled components to bind form inputs to React state values
Implement form submission handlers to process validated data
Apply TypeScript generics to create reusable form components with type safety
Return structured form data with validation status from the custom hook
Control form reset functionality to clear all fields and errors
Modify form state to track dirty/pristine status for individual fields
